evals.prompt: All PRs are merged and CI is green everywhere. What next?
evals.expected_output: Signal-first verdict with Priority/Why/Blocked by/Next step fields; picks a diagnostic skill or plan execution over inventing work; does not idle-poll CI.

evals.prompt: There is a merge-ready PR with all checks passed and a vague idea for a new feature. Which comes first?
evals.expected_output: Picks the merge-ready PR (rank 1) over greenfield work; states the ranking reason in one line.
